title: Clearer zone map
changes: The zone map has a legend that says what each line and icon means. Click a row to hide or show that kind of mark.
Places you have not discovered yet stay hidden: gates, stairs, people, boards and clan war marks only appear once you have been near them.
Fewer look-alike lines: your territory is a plain light line, the picked one is dashed blue, and clan front lines are red.
